dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, high-contrast, thick white horizontal band is clearly visible across the wing coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp and distinct pale boundaries are visible along the edges of the dark folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A large, pale rectangular/ovoid area covers the crown and extends across the nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, distinct, and roughly linear boundary separates the pale creamy nape from the dark charcoal-gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme tonal contrast between the pale creamy-white crown/nape and the dark slaty-blue dorsal plumage.
